ICE. It rattles, and drops a load into the bin for nobody.

A ledger in green cloth, open at April. The same name, all the way down the page.

A brass 6 on the door, and a light behind the curtains.
A chenille spread pulled tight. The pillow has not been touched.
A ceramic lamp with a paper shade gone brown on the side nearest the bulb.
A portable set on the dresser, rabbit ears bent to find Roswell.
The Sierra sign through a gap in the curtains, red and cyan, and the highway.
A beige phone. The cord runs to a wall jack marked OFFICE.
Shut. A tap drips behind it, steady as a clock.

A snapshot in a dime-store frame, turned a little towards the window.
The chain is off. The door to the walk, and the cold behind it.
